_comment: Source of truth for the positions page. Hand-edited when a position is opened or closed; build.py adds the live price and derives R. The thesis is written AT ENTRY - a thesis composed at exit is marking your own homework, and the whole point of the page is that the claim was on the record before the outcome was.
_symbol_note: Yahoo symbols. Japan 225 uses NIY=F, the yen Nikkei future, NOT ^N225: the spot index closes with Tokyo while CMC's cash CFD tracks the future, so ^N225 reads about 0.8% away from the platform and puts the stop distance visibly wrong.
_r_note: 1R is the distance from entry to the initial stop. Every outcome on this page is quoted in multiples of it, so positions of different sizes are comparable.

open.name: GBP/CHF
open.thesis: The franc is the funding leg of other people's trades, and a shock forces the same buy-back everywhere at once. The SNB has leaned against franc strength for a decade, and the position depends on that continuing.
open.catalyst: Entered within half a percent of the twelve-month high, after a 2.8% run over the prior quarter.
open.breaks: The Bank of England starts cutting towards the SNB, or the SNB stops leaning against a stronger franc.

open.name: Japan 225
open.thesis: Price weighting hands the index to a few high-priced exporters, and its sensitivity to the yen runs well ahead of the earnings underneath.
open.catalyst: Bought a pullback rather than a high: 10% below the twelve-month peak and in the bottom quarter of its three-month range.
open.breaks: The yen weakens and the index does not follow.

open.name: USD/MXN
open.thesis: Peso carry is the most crowded expression of the global rate gap: it pays steadily while positioning stays one-way and returns the lot in a single unwind.
open.catalyst: The pair closed at a twelve-month low two days before entry, having fallen 1.5% over the quarter.
open.breaks: Banxico starts cutting towards the Fed and the gap that pays the position closes.

_thesis_note: Three slots, all written AT ENTRY. thesis: what has to be true. catalyst: what made that day the day. breaks: what says it is wrong, which is not the stop being hit. An empty slot renders as an empty line rather than disappearing - see the position-thesis skill.
_dp_note: dp is DISPLAY precision only. The stored entry and stop keep their full precision, so R and the distance to the stop are unaffected by it.
_ccy_note: ccy is what the PRICE is quoted in: for a cross that is the quote currency (the second one), for an index the currency of the index.
